structure.unit: Taxes Administered by the Department of Taxation
Taxes on Suits and Other Judicial Proceedings

law.catch_line: Payment prerequisite to issue of writ, etc.; effect of failure to collect
law.text: No clerk shall issue any writ, or docket any removed or appealed warrant, or any notice mentioned in this article until the tax imposed under this article has been paid; however, his failure to collect the tax shall not invalidate the proceeding.
